title: Cookie Policy
intro: This page explains what cookies this website uses and how you can manage them.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies we use
paragraphs: This website uses a single functional cookie:
bullets: NEXT_LOCALE: stores your preferred language (e.g. "en", "hu", "sr-Latn"). This cookie is strictly necessary for the language switcher to work. It does not track you or collect personal data.

sections.heading: 2. No analytics or marketing cookies
paragraphs: We do not use analytics cookies, marketing cookies or any third-party tracking. There is no cookie consent banner because only a strictly functional cookie is set.

sections.heading: 3. How to clear the cookie
paragraphs: You can delete the NEXT_LOCALE cookie at any time through your browser settings. The website will continue to work; it will use your browser's language preference instead.

sections.heading: 4. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we add new cookies in the future, we will update this page and implement a cookie consent mechanism. The date at the top of this page indicates the last revision.
